overview: A beginner roadmap for using Excel to clean, analyze, and present data. It moves from spreadsheet basics to a practical analysis project.

phases.title: Spreadsheet Basics
phases.goal: Become comfortable entering, formatting, and organizing data.

nodes.title: Excel interface and worksheets
nodes.description: Learn how workbooks, worksheets, rows, columns, and cells work together. Practice navigating and formatting a small dataset.

nodes.title: Formulas and functions
nodes.description: Use formulas to calculate totals, averages, and percentages. Start with simple functions before combining them.

nodes.title: Sorting and filtering
nodes.description: Organize data so patterns are easier to see. Practice sorting, filtering, and freezing headers in a sample table.

resources.title: Sort data in a range or table
Filter data in a range or table

project.title: Clean a simple sales sheet
project.brief: Format a raw sales spreadsheet, add calculated columns, and create a clean table that is easy to scan.

phases.title: Analysis Tools
phases.goal: Summarize data with charts, tables, and common analysis functions.

nodes.title: Charts for comparison
nodes.description: Choose charts that match the question you are answering. Practice bar, line, and pie charts with clear titles.

resources.title: Create a chart from start to finish

nodes.title: Pivot tables
nodes.description: Use pivot tables to summarize large tables quickly. Focus on grouping, totals, and changing the view of the same data.

nodes.title: Lookup functions
nodes.description: Learn how lookup functions connect related tables. Use them carefully so your analysis stays accurate.

project.title: Monthly sales summary
project.brief: Build a summary workbook with pivot tables and charts that explain monthly sales by product and region.

resources.title: Create a chart from start to finish

phases.title: Present Insights
phases.goal: Turn analysis into clear findings and recommendations.

nodes.title: Ask analysis questions
nodes.description: Start every analysis with a clear question. Decide which columns and summaries can answer it.

nodes.title: Dashboard layout
nodes.description: Arrange charts and key numbers so viewers can understand the story quickly. Keep labels and colors simple.

resources.title: Create and share a Dashboard with Excel

nodes.title: Write findings
nodes.description: Summarize what changed, why it matters, and what action to take next. Use plain language instead of spreadsheet jargon.

project.title: Executive dashboard
project.brief: Create a one-page dashboard with three key metrics, two charts, and a short written recommendation.

resources.title: Create and share a Dashboard with Excel
